notes.title: the future of An Other Golf Game
notes.content:
H E L L O    E V E R Y O N E    
To keep everyone in the loop, here’s a quick update on the development.


Apologies for not being quite as active the last couple months, I have been trying to enjoy some summer weather and also spending some time working on a different weird experimental project in hopes to apply what I learn to An Other Golf Game. 



Below you will find what I have been working on and what's to come. I’ve left out ongoing optimizations and bug fixes, since those are a constant part of development and will continue to receive regular attention.

Active Development (likely this year)
Putting Overhaul
The putting system is being completely rebuilt from the ground up allowing for a more natural ball rolling experience. This task has fortunately and unfortunately snowballed quite a bit and to ensure the putting experience is generally better I have been reworking the golf ball physics as well as cleaning up the meshes that make up each hole at the golf course.



This part of the update is taking up most of the development time.


Mini Golf Course
There will be a mini golf course added to the world which should pair nicely with the putting overhaul that's in the works.


Cooking
You'll likely want to cook those raw chickens once the cooking update is in.


More Jobs
Currently there are 9 "jobs" in the world, most of which can be found at the golf course. One of the 9 jobs is a 7 part job available from the rat man, and to kick that job off you'll need to find him on Monday. 

There are a few more golf course related jobs that are in the works, and a few jobs and tasks that will be added that can be found elsewhere.

For some of the new jobs, expect to use the tractor.

Rain
Occasional California downpours are on the way. Weather severity will affect course conditions and shot behavior.


Other
There's a bunch of other things: 

Downsizing NPC bones

Refining the drunk effect 

Adding mushroom effects

Ball backspin


Future Development (next year and beyond)Tournament
This is more of the long term goal for the game and one of the most challenging things to try to create in an open world golf sim in which you have to take your own score. I don't expect to have this complete by this year whatsoever. I am hopeful that next year after I tackle the near term goals listed above, I can start to deep dive into the tournament.


More NPCs
Eventually there will be more NPCs roaming around the world, especially playing on the golf course. 


----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



Huge thanks to everyone who’s jumped into this niche, weird Early Access game, and my first game. Your feedback and bug reports are invaluable and truly make the experience better for everyone.



As always, if you have feedback, questions, concerns, want to share your experience, or ask me why there is no map at home, I'd love to hear it. Please use the steam forums or check out the discord.



thanks for your time
-waxycaps

notes.title: Urgent Care Update - 50110P4
notes.content:
Die less with this update, but probably wish you just died in the first place. Enjoy!

https://i.imgur.com/yhDN5z0.png
Build 50110P4

Updates
- Fatal player impact thresholds increased
- Injuries, if not fatal, will send you to URGENT CARE
- Going to urgent care can be costly depending on the injury and treatment needed
- Golf Marshal will now fine you instead of taking your life, mostly
- The player can have negative cash
- Radio gets more music
- Adding a few things in the background to support the occasional rainy day (rainy days to be added in the future)
- Some more clubs to be found in the world
- NPC vehicles that get stuck will now reset eventually instead of just turning off
- NPC vehicles are more performant
- Ambient Audio Manager more performant
- Gas pump hose reworked, functionality stays the same

Fixes
- Some minor UI updates
- Purchased Radios now also show station and power volume levels
- Radio speaker occasionally clipping audio fixed
- Removed "Radio On" text that displays briefly at game start
- Ice Bag no longer renders behind some materials
- Generally harder to die from physics weirdness, you absolutely still can, but various things have been put into place to try to protect against this
- Resolved bug that would cause ambient audio to stop playing/move to location that would be out of range of the player audio listener

Future
The next update will be focused on performance and quality of life changes and tweaks. As always, to find out more specifics, I will update the discord as the feature list is formed and worked on.


thanks
- waxycaps

notes.title: December 19th Update - 19th Hole - 19% Sale
notes.content:
hello hello hello

I've been quite busy the last month trying to get the "19th hole" into the game, and I think it's about time to share what I've got so far.

That said, I am excited to announce The Soggy Oak bar update is now available in the test beta branch!

In celebration of the "19th hole" being added, it also being the 19th, and I guess the holidays, I am having a 19% off sale through New Years.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45047068/cf071f57d177f0cf760baba9d24077ce2586a8ba.gif

This big update is available right now, in the test branch. As a reminder, anyone can opt in to the test branch, feel free to reach out in the Discord if you need some help.

Larger Updates

A new bar, The Soggy Oak, which has food, drinks, a TV with a variety of media, and a couple jobs available.

There is also a new Peninsula Park Area to explore.

Both the Bar, and the Park are still being heavily worked on and a lot more will be added to these areas with future updates.

Along with some of these larger content updates above, I have a bunch of other things that have been updated as well.

Updates

 Focus meter slows swing meter
 Targets on the driving range rearranged
 Bag club slots, bag pockets, golf cart scorecard holders get hover text to indicate location
 Tractor is less deadly
 Tree walls optimized
 Beer is stronger
 Towing Trailer
 Input settings for Attach Detach Trailer (must be in driving mode)
 Input settings for Quick Look (must be in golf mode)
 Camera Render Distance Settings
 Shadow Render Distance Settings
 Render Scale Settings

Fixes

 Rodents can only be hit once
 Jazz Intro, Cash Made achievements altered to ensure they trigger correctly
 Scorecard no longer causes golf cart death, you should still put the scorecard in the steering wheel

... and many other smaller changes and fixes

Feel free to hop into the discord if you have any questions or issues to report.

Thanks and Happy Holidays

-troy

notes.title: Post-Launch Recap
notes.content:
Post-Launch Recap: Two Weeks of Fun, Community, and Updates!

It’s hard to believe it’s already been two weeks since An Other Golf Game launched, or as some of you like to call it, Death Golf! A huge thank you to everyone who has been playing, sharing, and making this journey so incredible. Here’s a quick recap of what’s been happening:


A Growing Community
The community forming around An Other Golf Game has been nothing short of amazing. Whether it’s your creative gameplay strategies, hilarious in-game moments, or heartwarming support in Discord or the discussions, I couldn’t have asked for a better group of players. You’re truly bringing this world to life, and I’m so excited to see it grow even more.


Community Tournament
The first-ever An Other Golf Game Community Tournament is happening now! Thanks again Casual Elephant for setting this up and bringing the community together for some friendly competition. If you haven’t submitted your score yet, it’s not too late. The first tournament closes at the end of this weekend and there will be ongoing community tournaments happening at a regular cadence going forward. Stay tuned for updates and results—may the best golfer win!

Check it out here for more details on how to compete: https://elephante.net/anothergolfgame



New Beta Branch
The beta branch is live! This branch lets you try out experimental updates and give feedback on upcoming features before they go into the main game. Your input has already been incredibly valuable, and I’m working hard to fine-tune the game and of course bring meaningful updates. I am setting up a better way to share what's in these beta branches directly to Steam in an easy way, but for more details you can find information in the Discord.


Updates
Frequent updates are planned throughout the early stages of Early Access, with batch just around the corner—landing in just a few days! You can find details about the upcoming update in Discord, and full patch notes will be shared here on Steam once it goes live.


Twitch
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45047068/85b1e83fbf16015c876cebceab9b0177a3207677.png

I’ve been blown away by all the incredible Twitch streams and hilarious clips people have been sharing! At one point we had 4,400+ people watching the game be played. It has really been a highlight of these past two weeks. 

Have a great clip of your own? Share it on Discord! I’d love to see it.
https://discord.com/invite/xP9vy5pWp9


Thank you all again for making this launch such a memorable one. Your support means everything, and I’m so excited to see where we go next, I’m grateful to have you here.
